name: FiveM
description: FXServer for FiveM (GTA V multiplayer) with the default cfx-server-data resources. A free license key from https://portal.cfx.re is required. Allow 10 GB of disk and at least 4 GB of memory; servers with many resources need more.
startup_command: export TXHOST_FXS_PORT={{SERVER_PORT}} TXHOST_MAX_SLOTS={{MAX_PLAYERS}} TXHOST_DEFAULT_CFXKEY="${FIVEM_LICENSE}"; FX=/home/container/alpine; "$FX/opt/cfx-server/ld-musl-x86_64.so.1" --library-path "$FX/usr/lib/v8/:$FX/lib/:$FX/usr/lib/" -- "$FX/opt/cfx-server/FXServer" +set citizen_dir "$FX/opt/cfx-server/citizen/" +set sv_licenseKey "${FIVEM_LICENSE}" +set steam_webApiKey "${STEAM_WEBAPIKEY}" $( [ "${TXADMIN_ENABLE}" = "1" ] || [ "${TXADMIN_ENABLE}" = "true" ] || printf %s '+exec server.cfg' )

variables.name: License Key
variables.description: Cfx.re server key (cfxk_...) from https://portal.cfx.re. The server does not start without one.

variables.name: Server Name
variables.description: Name shown in the server list. Written to sv_hostname in server.cfg. Double quotes are not allowed.

variables.name: Max Players
variables.description: Highest number of players that can be connected at once. Written to sv_maxclients in server.cfg. More than 48 slots needs a Cfx.re subscription for the license key.

variables.name: FXServer Version
variables.description: Artifact to install: 'recommended', 'latest' or a full artifact id such as 7290-a654bcc2adfa27c4e020fc915a1a6343c3b4f921. Reinstall the server to change it.

variables.name: Steam Web API Key
variables.description: Key from https://steamcommunity.com/dev/apikey, needed only if resources identify players by their Steam account. Use 'none' otherwise.

variables.name: txAdmin
variables.description: Run the server under txAdmin, the web panel that ships with FXServer. txAdmin is reached on the txAdmin port, prints a PIN in the console on first start, and manages its own server.cfg under txData, so the Server Name above no longer applies.

variables.name: txAdmin Data Path
variables.description: Where txAdmin keeps its settings and the servers it deploys.
